FaqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqSection.subtitle: Common Queries
FaqSection.q1: How to find the cheapest flights?
FaqSection.a1: We compare prices from hundreds of airlines and travel agents worldwide in real-time. Enter your destination and dates in the search box, and we'll show you the cheapest available options. You can also check our Flash Deals.
FaqSection.q2: Are there hidden fees when booking?
FaqSection.a2: No, FlightChap is completely free to use. The prices you see in our search results are exactly what the airlines or travel agents charge. We don't add any hidden fees or booking charges.
FaqSection.q3: Can I change or cancel my flight?
FaqSection.a3: Flight changes and cancellations depend entirely on the airline or travel agency you booked with and the type of ticket you purchased. You should contact them directly using the details provided in your booking confirmation email.
FaqSection.a4: Flash Deals are highly discounted special flights that are only available for a very limited time. They are often updated daily and represent significant savings over normal fares.

Support.faq2Q: Can I give my ticket to someone else?
Support.faq2A: Most airlines do not allow name changes or ticket transfers. Instead, you must cancel and rebook.
